title: Separate review from applying
summary: apply performs the reviewed changes. A safe workflow checks scope, target and the exact plan before changing any real resources.
introduction: apply performs the reviewed changes. A safe workflow checks scope, target and the exact plan before changing any real resources. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Never run broad destruction commands against a project you do not fully own and understand.
For more detail later, use this [Terraform further reading](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/tutorials).
